newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends stronger, retain early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends stronger, retain early edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained an early edge to close firmer at 43.7500/7600 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday as a liquidity shortfall pushed call rates sharply up, dealers said.
Call money was traded at 13.0 to 15.0 percent against the previous 8.0-9.0 percent.
Dealers said the market suffered tight liquidity following payments against purchases of central bank bills worth more than one billion taka. The bills were auctioned on Wednesday.
